title: In 2006, a rescued dog saved Houssein Hamze from a bomb; in 2026, he refused to flee Lebanon and stayed to care for hundreds of animals
summary_full: Houssein Hamze turned his life around after his dog saved him from a devastating bomb attack, and he founded a shelter for abandoned animals in his village. Ignoring the threat of drone strikes, he continually provided food and water for displaced animals. His remarkable dedication attracted international recognition and donations, allowing him to persevere in his mission of promoting kindness towards animals.
